en.title: Is the Robot Bounded in a Circle
en.description:
A robot starts at coordinates (0,0) facing north and executes the commands G (move forward one step), L (turn left in place), and R (turn right in place). The command string repeats forever. Determine whether the robot's path always stays bounded; output YES if it is bounded, otherwise output NO.

The input protocol, examples, and test data are compiled by CSWork based on the original function problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..10), followed by n lines, each containing a command string of length 1..2500 consisting only of G, L, R.
en.output: For each command string, in input order, output YES or NO, one result per line.
en.explanation: The output is the result computed according to the problem rules; see the solution for the full algorithm.
hints: Simulate the commands once, recording the displacement and the final direction. If the robot is back at the origin, or its final direction differs from the initial one, the displacement cancels out periodically under repetition and the path is bounded; otherwise the displacement accumulates in the same direction every round and the path is unbounded.
